headline: NSTA commissions two studies to boost UK carbon storage market
summary: The UK's North Sea Transition Authority said the carbon storage industry had been given a 'significant boost' with the publication of two NSTA-commissioned studies aimed at accelerating development of the country's carbon storage market.
co2crc_note: UK storage-market enabling studies are a useful reference model for Australia's offshore storage regulatory and appraisal development.

headline: Singapore and Australia aim to conclude cross-border CCS instrument negotiations by year-end
summary: Singapore and Australia are targeting the end of 2026 to conclude negotiations on a bilateral legal instrument enabling cross-border CO2 transport and storage between the two countries.
co2crc_note: Cross-border CO2 export/storage frameworks directly enable Australian storage hubs to import regional CO2; a Singapore-Australia instrument is a template CO2CRC tracks closely.
extractor_note: Continues the year-end-target story flagged on the 30 Jul radar (Carbon Pulse 535933, 28 Jul); this distinct 30 Jul Carbon Pulse article (536055) is its first in-window appearance in a main section.

headline: Woodside's Browse declared a Western Australian state significant project
summary: The WA government declared Woodside's Browse project - which includes the proposed Browse offshore CCS component near Scott Reef - a 'state significant project', enabling more streamlined, coordinated approvals.
co2crc_note: Browse CCS progress and its Scott Reef social-licence scrutiny are bellwethers for Australian offshore storage permitting.

headline: PureField Ingredients launches 150,000 tpa Class VI CCS facility in Russell, Kansas
summary: PureField Ingredients held a ribbon-cutting for its 150,000 tpa carbon capture and sequestration facility in Russell, Kansas - permitted under the US EPA's Class VI program - capturing fermentation CO2 from its wheat-to-ethanol operation for permanent storage, and announced plans to double ethanol and sequestration capacity.
co2crc_note: A completed US Class VI ethanol-BECCS facility illustrates the pace of small-scale point-source CCS deployment under the 45Q/Class VI regime.
extractor_note: Ribbon-cutting 29 Jul 2026 (just outside the Fri 30-31 Jul window); PR distributed 30 Jul. Placed on radar, not a main fresh item.
